entities.summary: Kavell Chevano Bigby-Williams is a British professional basketball player for the Jilin Northeast Tigers of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He was named NABC NJCAA Player of the Year as a sophomore at Gillette College in 2016, before playing college basketball for the Oregon Ducks and the LSU Tigers.
